units.title: Engaging with the ancient [Country/City] world through texts

topics.title: Accessing and responding to [Classical Language] texts

subtopics.title: Accessing and responding to [Classical Language] texts

outcomes.text: access and interpret [Classical Language] texts to explore the ancient [Country/City] world
respond to texts and convey information in [Classical Language] or English, as appropriate
develop and apply strategies to interpret and translate [Classical Language] texts to convey meaning in English
understand and begin to apply the phonological and orthographic systems of [Classical Language]
develop knowledge of the vocabulary and structures and features of [Classical Language] grammatical systems to understand, translate and respond to texts
compare [Classical Language] vocabulary and language structures and features with English, using metalanguage

topics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

subtopics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

outcomes.text: recognise that language, texts and artefacts provide insights into culture and identity

units.title: Engaging with the ancient [Country/City] world through texts

topics.title: Accessing and responding to [Classical Language] texts

subtopics.title: Accessing and responding to [Classical Language] texts

outcomes.text: interpret [Classical Language] texts to analyse the society and culture of the ancient [Country/City] world
respond to texts and discuss ideas about ancient [Country/City] society in [Classical Language] or English, as appropriate
apply strategies to interpret and translate [Classical Language] texts to convey meaning and demonstrate understanding of context, purpose and audience
apply the phonological and orthographic systems of [Classical Language] in a range of contexts
select and use vocabulary, grammatical structures and linguistic features of [Classical Language] to interpret, translate and respond to texts
explain how [Classical Language] vocabulary, structures and features extend understanding of English, using metalanguage

topics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

subtopics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

outcomes.text: reflect on and explain how language, texts and artefacts provide understanding of culture and identity
